The leaves whisper to me... but alas! my stomach is growling. Pray tell, what did Mother Nature engift you with?
Like a breeze from the mountains, blowing since time immemorial, I have come to you from afar! Fill my innards with your good things!
To eat is mere indulgence for one of my kind, and yet... I cannot say I don't enjoy a good meal.
What of the forest that once stood where your inn is? It has been ages since I've last been here, nevertheless, it used to be a whole lot calmer around these parts.
I can't pay you save with song and dance. I've wandered long and far to get here.
Whenever I see my dear brothers and sisters of the forest being felled, I can't help but cry...
